name: vuln-platform
description: 漏洞管理平台 — 接收 ScanMan 扫描工具上报的漏洞与正负样本，提供登录、看板、漏洞查询与处置

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm -C apps/server dev" "pnpm -C apps/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm -C packages/shared build && pnpm -C apps/server build && pnpm -C apps/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C packages/shared build && pnpm -C apps/web typecheck && pnpm -C apps/server typecheck
